name: PT Capri Nusa Satu Properti Tbk
summary: PT Capri Nusa Satu Properti Tbk engages in the property and real estate development business in Indonesia. It develops resorts; and meeting houses and office buildings. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in East Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Capri Nusa Satu Properti Tbk is a subsidiary of PT RDW Global Investasi.
